faq.question: Who is this service for?
faq.answer: It is for Amazon sellers who need structured guidance setting up a US business entity as part of selling and brand operations readiness.

faq.question: Do you provide legal or tax advice?
faq.answer: No. We provide process guidance for sellers. Formal legal, tax, banking, or immigration advice should come from qualified professionals when your situation requires it.

faq.question: How does company registration relate to Amazon selling?
faq.answer: Entity and documentation readiness can affect account setup, banking, and brand-building timelines. We connect formation work to Amazon next steps such as Brand Registry planning and growth services.

faq.question: Can you help after the company is formed?
faq.answer: Yes. We support handoff into Amazon account readiness, Brand Registry planning, and growth services when those are in scope.

faq.question: How long does company registration take?
faq.answer: Timelines vary by state, entity type, document completeness, and third-party review. We outline expected stages during the free audit and do not guarantee formation or Amazon verification timelines.

faq.question: Is a US company required for every Amazon seller?
faq.answer: Not every seller needs the same structure. We assess whether US entity setup is relevant to your goals before recommending next steps.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support after setup?
faq.answer: After entity foundations are ready, we can support Amazon selling work across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Company registration guidance on this page is US-entity focused; marketplace scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a needs assessment, formation pathway plan, then Amazon readiness handoff.
